nodes.label: CLDataset (abstract interface)

nodes.label: BaseCLModel (abstract interface)
nodes.rationale: Unified model interface (predict, update, on_task_end, estimate_ram_bytes, count_parameters, save, load) ensuring all CL models are interchangeable for evaluation.

nodes.label: Gap 1 — Validation on real industrial time-series data

nodes.label: Gap 2 — CL under 100 Ko RAM with precise measured figures

nodes.label: Gap 3 — INT8 quantization during incremental training backpropagation

nodes.label: HDC (Hyperdimensional Computing) classifier
nodes.rationale: Architecture-based CL method with no catastrophic forgetting by construction (additive prototype memory). Binary XOR/POPCOUNT operations efficient on Cortex-M4 DSP. D=1024, RAM <12 Ko. Lower accuracy bound + upper frugality bound among 3 models.

nodes.label: HDC Hypervectors (D=1024, binary {-1,+1})

nodes.label: EWC Online (Elastic Weight Consolidation)
nodes.rationale: Regularization-based CL: EWC penalizes changes to weights important for previous tasks (Fisher diagonal). Online variant (Schwarz 2018) accumulates Fisher with decay γ → fixed RAM overhead (×3 vs model alone) regardless of number of tasks. SGD (not Adam) for MCU compatibility.

nodes.label: EWC MLP (6→32→16→1, ~9Ko FP32 total)
nodes.rationale: Minimal MLP architecture: 769 params + Fisher diag + snapshot θ* = 2307 scalars ≈ 9Ko FP32. Fits NUCLEO-F439ZI (256Ko) with huge margin. ReLU only (INT8-friendly via CMSIS-NN).

nodes.label: Fisher Diagonal (EWC weight importance)
nodes.rationale: Diagonal Fisher matrix approximation: F_i ≈ E[(∂ log p(y|x,θ)/∂θ_i)²]. Pre-computed once per task, loaded from Flash on MCU. Online variant uses decay factor γ=0.9.

nodes.label: TinyOL (frozen backbone + OtO online head)
nodes.rationale: Architecture-based CL: backbone pre-trained offline then frozen in Flash (read-only). Only OtO head (10 params, 40B FP32) updated online via SGD. Backbone in Flash = ROM, head in RAM = RW. Anti-forgetting via frozen backbone.

nodes.label: TinyOL Backbone Autoencoder (25→32→16→8, 1496 params encoder)
nodes.rationale: MSE pre-training on normal data only. Encoder frozen after pretraining. 5.8Ko FP32, 1.5Ko INT8.

nodes.label: TinyOL OtO Head (9→1, 10 params, 40B FP32)
nodes.rationale: Input: embedding z (8D) + MSE scalar = 9D. Only trainable part in deployment. SGD without momentum (no extra RAM). Online update per sample.

nodes.label: UINT8 Latent Replay Buffer (TinyOL extension)
nodes.rationale: Based on Ravaglia 2021 QLR-CL. Store embeddings z as UINT8 instead of FP32 → ×4 compression. Buffer: 50×8×1B=400B + labels 50B = ~450B total. Addresses Gap 3 exploratorily.
